dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "No, just listen to me. There's a huge world out there! Mondstadt, Liyue, Inazuma... Compared to the size of those places, these islands are just a few pebbles in a pond!"

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "*sigh* Never mind, forget it. Alright. That's it then. The rest of my life, here... eating nuts and berries, and... waiting around to die."
